games.title: Games
games.subtitle: In-house originals with a verifiable result, plus the provider content a licensed operator would carry.
games.lobbyNotice: Casino games settle in seconds rather than over ninety minutes, which makes losses accumulate far faster than in sports betting. Everything here is simulated: the balance is a session number in your browser, no money is involved, and no round can be staked for real.
games.demoNotice: Demonstration credits, not money. Every round is decided on the server from your committed seed, and each stake and payout is recorded in your account ledger.
games.playableSummary: {count} originals are playable. Everything else needs a provider connection, which needs a casino licence first.
games.originals.description: Built in this codebase. Every result is derived from a seed you can check.
games.providerSection.description: Supplied by a third-party studio. Not connected in this build.
games.providers.title: Providers
games.providers.description: Where the catalogue's content would come from, and how each would connect.
games.providers.explainer: Third-party casino content is not reachable through a public API. Every studio is a commercial agreement that requires an operating licence covering casino games — a sports-betting licence does not extend to them — plus per-territory whitelisting on the provider's side, certified RNG, an integration tested by an accredited laboratory, and credentials issued to the licensed entity. None of that can be arranged in code, so no provider is connected here and their titles cannot be opened.

games.fair.revealedHint: Covers the {count} rounds played on the previous pair.
games.fair.demoCaveat: The arithmetic here is the real scheme and verifies correctly. The guarantee behind it does not exist in this build: with no server, the seed is generated in your own browser, so nothing was committed to by a party that could not also change it. Provably fair only means something when the server holds the seed and computes the outcome.
games.verify.title: Verify a round
games.verify.subtitle: Re-derive any past result from its seeds. This page has no special access — it runs the same functions the games run.
games.verify.step.1: Before you bet, you are shown the SHA-256 hash of a secret server seed.
games.verify.step.2: You supply a client seed, so the operator cannot know the full input either.
games.verify.step.3: Each round uses HMAC-SHA256 over serverSeed and "clientSeed:nonce:cursor".
games.verify.step.4: Rotating your seed reveals the old server seed. Hash it: if it matches the commitment you were shown, every round on that pair was fixed in advance.
games.verify.serverSeedHint: Only available after you rotate the pair it belongs to.
games.verify.hashHint: Optional. Paste the commitment you were shown to check it against the seed.
games.verify.commitmentOk: The seed hashes to the commitment. This round was fixed before it was played.
games.verify.commitmentFailed: The seed does not hash to that commitment. Check both values.
games.verify.prefillBody: You have a rotated pair in this session.
games.verify.minesResult: With 3 mines, bombs would sit on tiles {tiles}
games.verify.plinkoResult: Plinko would land in bucket {bucket} at {multiplier}×
games.tagline.slots: Five reels, ten lines, one house edge you can check
games.slots.paytableNote: Payouts are per line, for 3 / 4 / 5 matching from the left. Wilds substitute for everything except scatters. Three or more scatters pay {scatter3}× to {scatter5}× the total bet and award {spins} free spins with every win multiplied by {multiplier}.
games.slots.honestyNote: These figures are enumerated over all 7,962,624 reel positions, not estimated. "Wins below the stake" is shown because a slot celebrating a return smaller than what you paid is still a loss — most machines do not tell you how often that happens.
games.roulette.prompt: Place chips on the table, then spin
games.roulette.edgeNote: Single zero. Every bet pays as if the wheel had 36 pockets while it has 37 — that one pocket is the entire 2.70% house edge, on every bet type equally.
games.blackjack.rules: Four-deck shoe. Dealer stands on soft 17, blackjack pays 3:2, split aces receive one card each. The shoe stays on the server — the hole card is not sent to your browser until the dealer's turn.
games.serverFair.title: Server-resolved
games.serverFair.body: The shoe, the wheel and the payout are decided on the server with a cryptographic random source; your browser only draws the result. Unlike the provably-fair originals there is no commitment you can verify afterwards, so this is a weaker guarantee — it protects against a tampered client, not against the operator.
games.fair.signIn: Sign in to see your seed commitment. Every round is drawn from a seed pair the server committed to before you bet.
games.fair.caveat: The server committed to its seed before your bet, so it cannot pick an outcome after seeing it. Rotate to reveal the old seed, then re-derive any past round yourself on the verify page.
